premises.text: Red Beacon provides a platform for consumers to request local services from businesses.
premises.evidence_span: it's a website where you can request virtually any kind of local service.

premises.text: Local businesses can quote prices and offer appointment times through Red Beacon.
premises.evidence_span: local businesses who've signed up for Red Beacon receive the job and they're able to quote a price and offer appointment times.

premises.text: Red Beacon operates on a pay-for-performance model, charging businesses only when a job is booked.
premises.evidence_span: we're only going to charge businesses if a consumer books the job with them and actually does work.

premises.text: Consumers require extensive information before booking a service online.
premises.evidence_span: consumers really need all kinds of information.

premises.text: Red Beacon is expanding geographically to acquire more service professionals.
premises.evidence_span: we're beginning our expansion, and over the last several weeks, we've been acquiring service professionals.

premises.text: An embeddable widget will allow other websites to access Red Beacon's service provider network.
premises.evidence_span: we're creating an embeddable widget, which basically makes our high-quality service provider network available to any website.

value.text: Consumers can easily book local services with transparency and convenience.
value.evidence_span: we've really tried to increase the price transparency and make it very easy to schedule jobs online.
